2. Samsung par install karo, phir app kholo.

Samsung us link par tap karte hi jud jayega - phir is phone se Controls AUR Screen (Samsung ki screen dekhna/chalana) dono kaam karenge.

2. Download hote hi Install dabao ("Blocked" dikhe to Settings mein jaakar is baar Allow karke wapas Install dabao)
3. App khol lo, bas itna hi - ab agla message aane ka wait karo

1. Is poore message ko copy karo (App pehle se install hona chahiye - agar nahi hai to pehla message dekho)
2. HeatGuard app kholo
3. Code apne aap lag jayega

Phir is (pehle wale) phone se "Controls" ya "Screen" (screen dekhna/chalana) dabao.
Jud gaya. Ab doosra phone is phone ko control kar sakta hai.
Usage access do (app ka naam batane ke liye)
Is phone par ye screen nahi mili.
Drain: abhi naapa nahi (pehle check ka intezaar)
Poora mode: app ka naam bhi bata sakta hoon
Simple mode: sirf garmi aur drain

Naam bhi chahiye to ek baar laptop se ye chalaiye:

adb shell pm grant com.mustfa.heatguard android.permission.DUMP

Ek hi baar. Reboot ke baad bhi rehti hai.
Poora mode chalu hai. Pehla naap chal raha hai - agle check (15 minute) ke baad app ka naam dikhne lagega.

DUMP mil chuki hai par CPU list nahi mil rahi. Do wajah ho sakti hain: (1) Usage access nahi di - neeche wala button dabaiye, ya (2) Android ne service tak pahunch rok di. Tab tak app garmi aur drain wale mode par chalti rahegi, jo apna kaam theek karta hai.

Samsung wala \'ek button se saari apps deep sleep\' ek app nahi kar sakti: Android CHANGE_APP_IDLE_STATE kisi bhi app ko deta hi nahi, adb se bhi nahi. Upar wala button phone ki apni battery screen kholta hai, jahan ye haath se ho jata hai. Sab ek saath karne ke liye laptop se: phone-care.ps1 -DeepSleepUnused

Ye wahi teen listein hain jo Samsung dikhata hai. Kisi bhi app par tap kijiye - uska apna page khulega, jahan Battery mein jaa kar use Restricted kar sakte hain. Tap ke baad wapas aaiye, list apne aap update ho jayegi.
Background bilkul band. Notification bhi nahi aayegi. App kholte hi normal ho jaati hai.
Background mein kabhi kabhi chalegi. Notification der se aa sakti hai.
Kabhi nahi sulayi jayengi. Jo apps aapko hamesha chahiye wo yahan rakhiye.
Kisi bhi line par tap kijiye. Saari apps ki list khulegi jisme tick box honge - tick lagaiye ya hataiye, phir DONE dabaiye.
%1$d apps chhod di (call/SMS/bank/2FA wagairah) - wo so gayin to OTP aur alarm ruk jate.

Bucket badalne ke liye Shizuku chahiye. Android ye adhikaar (CHANGE_APP_IDLE_STATE) kisi bhi app ko deta hi nahi - Samsung kar leta hai kyunki uski Settings app firmware ke saath sign hoti hai. Shizuku free hai aur aapke phone par wireless debugging pehle se ON hai, to wo bina laptop ke shuru ho jata hai.
Is list mein koi app nahi.
Buckets padhe nahi ja sake. Iske liye Usage access chahiye (aur DUMP permission, jo laptop se ek baar milti hai).
Shizuku chal raha hai - ab ek button se sab ho sakta hai, bilkul Samsung ki tarah.
%1$d apps ko deep sleep mein daalo

Bulk button in apps ko chhod deta hai: call, SMS, WhatsApp, Telegram, alarm, calendar, bank/UPI/Google Pay, aur 2FA authenticator. Wo so gayin to OTP aur alarm ruk jayenge. Inhe sulana ho to neeche list se ek-ek kar ke kijiye.
Shizuku chal raha hai par usne abhi ijazat nahi di.

Ek button se saari apps sulane ke liye Shizuku chahiye (free app). Uske bina neeche se ek-ek app haath se set kar sakte hain. Aapke phone par wireless debugging pehle se ON hai, to Shizuku bina laptop ke hi shuru ho jata hai - bas reboot ke baad har baar ek baar.
Nahi ho paya. Shizuku band to nahi ho gaya?

Ek hi button se SAARI apps deep sleep karna ek app ke bas ka nahi: Android ne wo adhikaar (CHANGE_APP_IDLE_STATE) sirf firmware ke saath sign hui apps ke liye rakha hai - isiliye Samsung kar leta hai. Sab ek saath karne ke liye laptop se: phone-care.ps1 -DeepSleepUnused

Neeche button dabao - Telegram mein seedha BotFather ki chat khul jayegi (ye Telegram ka apna bot hai, jo naye bot banata hai). Wahan type karo: /newbot\n\nFir jo naam maange wo de do (kuch bhi chalega, jaise "Mera Phone"). Fir jo @username maange, uske end mein "bot" hona chahiye (jaise saifu_heat_bot) - wahi likh do.

BotFather ek lambi seedhi si line degi, kuch aisi: 123456789:AAExampleTextYahanAayegi12345\n\nUs poore message ko copy karo (message par lambi der tap karo, phir Copy). Wapas HeatGuard mein aao - neeche apne aap aa jayegi, bas Save dabana hai.
Ab ek link banegi jo Samsung ko bhejni hai. Wahan tap karke START dabate hi wo phone is phone ka remote ban jayega.
Telegram installed nahi hai is phone par.
Token clipboard se mil gaya - neeche Save dabao.
Abhi koi link nahi bani. Uper wala button dabaiye.
Link nahi ban payi. Token sahi hai? Internet chal raha hai?

Is link par tap kijiye aur START dabaiye - phir isi chat se phone chalega.

Test theek hai - Heat Guard jud gaya.
Abhi tak koi message nahi mila. Pehle apne bot ko Telegram se koi message bhejiye, phir dobara Test dabaiye.
Message nahi ja paya. Token sahi hai? Internet chal raha hai?
Ye BotFather ka token nahi lagta. Token mein ek colon (:) hota hai, jaisa: 123456789:AAHqX8yZ... Pairing code (jaisa maaci9gr3344) alag cheez hai - wo doosre feature ka hai, yahan nahi chalega.
Token save ho gaya. Ab uper se control link bhejiye.
Jude hue chat ko bhool jao
Bhool gaya. Agla message bhejne wala naya malik banega.
Abhi kisi chat se juda nahi. Uper se control link bhejiye.

Suraksha: bot sirf EK chat ki sunta hai - jo control link se aata hai wahi. Link mein ek-baar ka code hota hai, jo istemal hote hi mit jata hai aur 30 minute mein khud mar jata hai. Baaki sab chup-chaap phenk diye jate hain. TOKEN KISI KO MAT DIJIYE: jiske paas token hoga wo is phone ko command bhej sakta hai. Galti se kahin chala jaye to BotFather par /revoke kar ke naya bana lijiye. Aur dhyan rahe - status aur command ka output Telegram ke server se guzarta hai.

Der kitni: chetavni TURANT jaati hai (phone khud bhejta hai). Aapke bheje command mein der lag sakti hai - phone jab jeb mein pada ho to Android use bar-bar jagne nahi deta, isliye 10-15 minute lag sakte hain. Phone chalu ho to jawab jaldi aata hai.
Ye phone abhi kisi role mein nahi hai
YE PHONE: isse control KIYA JAYEGA

Yahi app dono phone mein daaliye. Ek phone batata hai ki use control kiya jayega, doosra use control karta hai.\n\nPassword kabhi type nahi karna padega. Ek baar ek pairing code doosre phone par daalna hai - bas, Bluetooth pair karne ki tarah.
Is phone ko control KIYA JAYEGA (Redmi)
Dono phone ntfy.sh relay se judte hain. Command aur screen encrypt hokar jaate hain: relay ko pairing code nahi dikhta, seedhi tasveer nahi milti. Code kisi aur ko mat dijiye.

Ye session 10 minute chalti hai, phir khud band. Upar notification rahegi - battery lagegi, isliye kaam khatam hote hi band kar dijiye. Tasveer har 10 second mein badlegi. ntfy.sh 5 second mein ek se zyada request nahi lene deta, isliye ye video nahi hai. Tap usi der mein pahunchta hai.

Kya karein: neeche Battery usage kholiye. Jo app sabse upar hai aur aapne use ki hi nahi - wahi culprit hai. Uspar tap kar ke Force stop dabaiye.

Bina Shizuku ke ye app kisi doosri app ko na maar sakti hai, na deep sleep mein daal sakti hai: wo adhikaar (FORCE_STOP_PACKAGES, CHANGE_APP_IDLE_STATE) Android kisi bhi normal app ko deta hi nahi - maine aapke phone par khud test kiya. Tab bhi ye gadbad SHURU hote hi khabar de deti hai aur seedha sahi screen tak le jaati hai; pichhli baar pata chalne mein 3 din lage the. Shizuku chalu ho to dono kaam ek tap mein ho jate hain.
